items.title: 17.7.2 Choone ke pathar se quicklime (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the production of quicklime (PDF 13).

blocks.text: Choone ke pathar (calcium carbonate) se quicklime (calcium oxide) banana qadeem tareen aur bunyadi sanati amal mein se hai. Quicklime tameer (cement, mortar), zaraat (mitti ka ilaaj), dhaat kaari aur bohat si kimiyai sanaton mein zaroori hai. Choone ka pathar wafir sedimentary chattan hai jo zyada tar calcium carbonate se bana hai.

Choone ka pathar lime kiln mein taqreeban 900-1000 C tak garam kiya jata hai, yeh thermal decomposition calcination kehlata hai: garam karne par CaCO3(s) -> CaO(s) + CO2(g). Jadeed bhattiyon mein maal ghoomti garam gases se garam hota hai. Band bartan mein reaction ulat sakta hai, is liye carbon dioxide musalsal nikali jati hai; is se equilibrium daen taraf jata aur zyada maal milta hai.

blocks.alt: Patthar ki lime kiln (bhatti) ka kata hua manzar. Pisa hua choone ka pathar (CaCO3) gaari se chimney ke oopar daala jata hai (INPUT). Jalne wale hisse mein, 900-1000 C par, baen se fuel burner aur daen se coal aur natural gas aati hai. Neeche jaali (grate) par CaO jama hota hai, neeche se teer oopar jate hain, aur CaO gaari mein bahar nikalta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.5: CaCO3 ke reaction se lime (CaO) banta hai jis ke bohat se istemal hain (kitab ki Figure 17.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki tasveer jalne wale hisse par 600 C aur 300 C likhti hai, magar kitab ka apna text 900-1000 C kehta hai aur Table 17.3 ke mutabiq CaCO3 900 C par toot'ta hai; is liye khaake mein 900-1000 C likha hai, yahi durust hai. Tasveer ke burner par 'FIEAL TOAL' ghalat chhapa hai; yahan 'Fuel' likha hai. Pathar oopar se neeche aata hai, garam hisse mein CaCO3 -> CaO + CO2 hota hai, neeche ke teer hawa ke andar aane ko dikhate hain, aur CO2 gases ke saath oopar nikal jati hai.

blocks.prompt: Lime kiln se carbon dioxide musalsal kyun nikali jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Maal (product) nikalne se equilibrium CaCO3 <=> CaO + CO2 daen taraf jata hai, is liye zyada choone ka pathar tootta aur zyada quicklime milta hai.

items: CO2 nikalne se reaction daen taraf.
